operator_io_quirks: Table 'Answer' is a quoted mixed-case identifier in DDL; 'Question'/'Survey' unquoted — keep original spelling, quote all in generated SQL.
Answer has 234640 rows (>200k) — read_schema must rowid-sample, not full-scan, and original_sizes uses count(*).
Answer PK is composite (UserID, QuestionID) — composite-PK member gets max_l0=30, not inf.

Answer.SurveyID FK -> Survey.SurveyID but Answer has only 4 distinct SurveyIDs (2014,2016,2017,2018) while Survey has 5 (adds 2019) — FK child values are a strict subset of parent; parent 2019 unused.
Answer.QuestionID FK -> Question.questionid; parent column name differs in case (questionid vs QuestionID) — case-insensitive column lookup required.
All columns notnull=0 despite PKs; no CHECK/UNIQUE constraints beyond PKs — nothing enforced in Python, insert failures skipped.
AnswerText is TEXT but stores numeric-looking strings ('37','44','32') — String fuzzer will treat int-like strings and add i±1 variants.
questiontext TEXT with long free text incl. trailing space ('...which ') — String length range derived from these.
SurveyID values are years (2014..2019) stored as INTEGER, declared INTEGER -> Number fuzzer, not Date/Year; no year dispatch.
No dangling FKs, no self-references, no missing parents here — clean FK graph Question<-Answer->Survey.
Survey has only 5 rows; Question 105 — tiny parents, so FK draws with replacement will heavily repeat parent values.
Description strings embed the year ('mental health survey for 2014') — literal pool may tie Description to SurveyID values.
operator_ts_expectations: Question.questionid / Survey.SurveyID: Number fuzzer, int scale 0, range [-1,1] full-range plus element perturbation (+-1,+-2) — fresh draws cluster near 0, far from real 1..105 / 2014..2019.
Survey.SurveyID fresh Number draws (near 0) will not match Answer.SurveyID FK values (2014..2018) -> joins on SurveyID often empty (FN risk).

Answer.SurveyID/QuestionID/UserID: Number fuzzer; FK columns instead copy parent values with replacement, so SurveyID in Answer stays in {2014,2016,2017,2018} only if parent Survey.SurveyID survived PK/unique filtering.
AnswerText: String fuzzer over charset a-zA-Z 0-9() with contamination — produces junk strings, not the numeric answer codes ('37','44') -> equality/aggregation on AnswerText implausible (FN).
questiontext/Description: String fuzzer random strings, not English questions -> LIKE/contains predicates on text rarely match (FN).
Composite PK (UserID,QuestionID): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate tuples; with 3763x105 space and small sizes duplicates rare, but UserID fresh draws near 0 collide -> some PK dedup.
No single-column unique columns -> drop_unique_duplicates mostly no-op.
Table sizes: level-based or rand_lin; Answer (level 2) can reach ~2500 rows vs 234640 original — scale mismatch may make COUNT/aggregate thresholds miss (FP/FN).
Number fuzzer list_max quirk (upper end overwritten to full range) means even element-seeded columns draw fresh values outside observed range -> implausible SurveyID/QuestionID (FN).
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3 -> some instances pure element reuse (closer to real), others mostly fresh junk.
Empty parent (if Survey filtered to 0 rows) -> Answer.SurveyID all NULL, breaking NOT-NULL-free joins silently.
No Date/Time/Bool columns -> those fuzzers unused; all dispatch is Number or String.
